method: Native Win32 GDI DrawText in a non-activating, offscreen WinForms window; PrintWindow(PW_CLIENTONLY) captures each native window. No bitmap resizing or manual RGB construction.
dpiMeaning: dpi is source font/layout percentage. targetDpi=96/outputScaleY, independently rasterized with lfHeight=-round(9pt*targetDpi/72). Output nominal em is 12 px; actualOutputFontHeightPx records GDI integer em rounding. actualWindowDpi is the unchanged host monitor DPI. scaleKey identifies the source rasterization, not an image resize.
